query:
-- Check all the key races we corrected
SELECT 'GOVERNOR' as type, state_code, dem_candidate, rep_candidate, status 
FROM governor_races WHERE state_code IN ('TX','GA','PA')
UNION ALL
SELECT 'SENATE', state_code, candidate1_name, candidate2_name, status 
FROM senate_races WHERE state_code IN ('AL','GA','KY','LA','TX','OH')
UNION ALL
SELECT 'HOUSE', CONCAT(state_code,'-',district), candidate1_name, candidate2_name, status 
FROM house_races WHERE (state_code='KY' AND district='4')
   OR (state_code='OH' AND district IN ('3','5','7','8','10','15'))
   OR (state_code='PA' AND district IN ('1','3'))
   OR (state_code='IN' AND district='8')
   OR (state_code='GA' AND district IN ('1','5'))
ORDER BY type, state_code;
